big_chains.name: Stop & Shop via Instacart (approx.)
big_chains.label: Stop & Shop via Instacart (approx.)
big_chains.store: Instacart's price for Stop & Shop, approx. · read Oct 18
big_chains.note: Read on Instacart's Stop & Shop storefront for this area (logged out, Oct 18). Instacart shows a pricing-policy link for Stop & Shop, not a “no markups” label, so these prices are approximate: Stop & Shop's own site blocks automated reading, so in-store prices could not be checked. Every price read ends like a normal shelf price (.99, .69, .49), which a percentage markup would not leave, so no markup was taken off. Matched by exact brand, product and size. Instacart's fees are not included. Confirm in store.
